intro1: Children don’t need another screen competing for their attention. They need experiences that help them think better, feel better and grow with confidence.
intro2: At Ikigyan, every book, activity and learning experience is designed to build the skills that matter beyond the classroom.
imageAlt: A child looks up thoughtfully at desk, surrounded by five circles representing financial, emotional, physical, social and digital learning.

reasons.label: Builds the mind
reasons.copy: Helping children understand their thoughts, emotions, choices and strengths.

reasons.label: Prepares them for real life
reasons.copy: Making money, decision-making, responsibility and everyday life skills easier to understand.

reasons.label: Develops healthy habits
reasons.copy: Encouraging physical wellbeing, self-care, discipline and balanced routines.

reasons.label: Helps them navigate the world
reasons.copy: Building empathy, communication, respect, relationships and social responsibility.

reasons.label: Designed with safety in mind
reasons.copy: Age-appropriate content, thoughtful experiences and minimal dependence on digital engagement.

reasons.label: Learning that goes beyond the screen
reasons.copy: Books, puzzles, activities and experiences children can explore independently or with their families.

closingLead: Because education isn’t only about getting ahead.
closingHighlight: It’s about being ready for life.
